newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Mahr Tunel draws interest - report.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Mahr Tunel draws interest - report.

text.p: Seven foreign and four domestic companies are interested in the privatization of mining company Mahr Tunel SA, owned by state miner Centromin, government daily El Peruano said Monday.

The companies include Sweden's Boliden AB, Mexico's Industrias Penoles SA, Grupo Mexico SA and Minera Penoles del Peru, Switzerland's Glencore International, Australia's Savage Resources Ltd, and the United States' Sunshine Mining & Refining CO.
Local companies Minsur SA, Volcan, Morococha SA and Arcata Hoschild are also interested in bidding, El Peruano added.
Centromin will formally take offers on June 16 and announce the winner June 20.
Mahr Tunel SA controls the San Cristobal and Andaychagua mines, which lie close to each other in the central Peruvian highlands.
